decision.recommendation: Keep Sol diagnosis; evaluate Luna medium writing further for cost. No stable latency winner established. Address shared extraction reliability and confidence consistency before selecting a new default.

controls: Luna medium extraction in every profile
Medium diagnosis; only designated model/writing-effort settings vary
Two case workers; profile order rotates by file pair
Fresh control and same fixture bytes
Retain failures and retry costs; report selected repeats separately
review_method: Codex source-grounded assistant review of narratives, hypotheses, alternatives and open questions against synthetic fixture expectations. Automated provenance, metadata, citations, coverage and route checks plus actual frontend projection. No independent domain-expert adjudication or extra model judge.
limitations: Small synthetic English-language set, mostly mapping/master-data failures
One main observation per file/profile; selected hard-case repeat is exploratory
Timing includes shared extraction variability and retries; not browser rendering
Cost uses saved application price catalogue, not provider invoice
No real-customer-log, production load or adversarial evaluation
